JUDGMENT:
                      J U D G M E N T
Nanavati, J.
     This appeal arises out of the judgment and order passed
by the Patna High  Court in Criminal appeal No. 201 of 1992.
     Having gone through the evidence of P.W. 2 and other
witnesses and also the judgment of the High Court, we do not
find any infirmity either in the evidence of P.W. 2 - Arti
Devi or in appreciation of her evidence by the Courts below.
     This appeal is, therefore, dismissed.
